purpose: Issue #4414: add an owner-only, read-only PC-CROP presentation showroom under the privileged staff boundary so one real PLATFORM_OWNER MFA session can inspect thirteen synthetic cabinet surfaces without impersonating business users, weakening production RBAC, enabling public demo credentials, or sending the owner token to business-data APIs.
requiredInvariants: Only a server-verified PLATFORM_OWNER session with MFA may render the showroom.
The showroom stays under the privileged staff boundary and does not mint or impersonate business-user sessions.
Normal platform-v7 role, user, membership, organization and tenant equality checks remain unchanged.
No passwordless demo route, shared public credential, role-test credential or canonical test seed is enabled in production.
The owner access token is used only for staff authority verification and is never sent to business-data endpoints from the showroom.
All displayed organizations, role facts, deal facts and amounts are synthetic presentation data.
All operations that could mutate a deal, payment, document, lab result, arbitration state or external integration are disabled in showroom rendering.
The employee organization-profile surface is included alongside the twelve existing execution-role surfaces.
Every showroom screen is visibly marked TEST or SHOWROOM and robots indexing is disabled.
No database, migration, secret, production environment, external integration or recurring-cost change is included.
acceptance: Focused unit source contract proves PLATFORM_OWNER plus MFA gating.
Focused unit source contract proves exactly the thirteen requested showroom surfaces are represented.
Focused unit source contract proves no business proxy/deals/logistics/lab workspace fetch is present.
Focused unit source contract proves mutating cockpit actions are disabled and SHOWROOM labeling is present.
Exact-head web unit, Node CI, security and governance checks pass before merge.
Production acceptance opens all thirteen showroom surfaces from one real owner session and records the exact deployed SHA.
